meta.name: customize-starter
meta.description: Turn this React boilerplate into a real project. Use when starting a new project from this starter, renaming it, removing demo/starter content, or when the user mentions "customize starter", "rename project", "remove boilerplate demo", or "initialize from template".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 React 模板改成正式项目,清理演示代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果拿到 React 样板想快速改成自己的项目
copy.tagline_en: Turn a React boilerplate into a real project by renaming and clearing demo content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a React boilerplate and want to make it your own

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会按清单改造这个React样板：更新package.json等文件里的项目名，删除home演示功能，配置GA4和Sentry监控，并运行类型检查、测试和构建验证。它只改你要求的内容，保留可复用的基础设施。
howto.when: 当你提到“customize starter”、“rename project”等关键词，或要求从该模板初始化新项目、重命名、移除演示内容时触发。

say.text: 把这个项目改名为我的新项目，更新所有相关配置
删除home演示功能，换上我自己的根组件
帮我配置GA4和Sentry的监控与上报
say.note: 会在环境变量里填入你的跟踪ID和DSN

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will customize this React starter by renaming the project in config files, removing the demo home feature, setting up analytics/monitoring, and running checks and build. It only edits what you ask and keeps reusable infra.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you start a new project from this starter, rename it, or remove demo content, or when you mention 'customize starter', 'rename project', etc.

say_en.text: Rename this boilerplate to my project and update all related configs.
say_en.note: Updates package.json, index.html, env files, etc.

say_en.text: Remove the home demo feature and swap in my root component.
Set up GA4 and Sentry monitoring for me.
say_en.note: Fills env vars with your tracking ID and DSN.
